title: Sanio language - Wikipedia
text: Sanio, or more precisely Saniyo-Hiyewe, is a Sepik language of Tunap/Hunstein Rural LLG in East Sepik Province, northern Papua New Guinea. It is also spoken in Telefomin Rural LLG, Sandaun Province.

title: Saniyo-Hiyewe | Ethnologue Free
text: Saniyo-Hiyewe is a stable indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Sepik language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
